results.bug: Race conditions in async member loading

matched.title: findMembers applies responses in arrival order, so a stale page can overwrite a newer one

results.judgeReason: Finding #2 identifies the race condition in async member loading: findMembers in group.js fires overlapping requests with no in-flight guard and applies responses in arrival order, so a stale response can overwrite newer members/offset. It also notes that reloads from addMembers/removeMember race with paging. This matches the known bug's root cause and location and explains the impact.
